# Fernhill Studio's superobjective

**Within twelve months, a national garden centre chain stocks our planting kits in every store.**

Every superproject Fernhill Studio runs serves this, through one of the signs below.

## In their words (2026-10-18, Maya and Jonah, at the studio)

Jonah: "If the kits are in every store, nobody has to find us. That's the whole thing."

Maya: "Okay, simpler: a chain says yes within the year. That's it."

Maya, later the same day: "Every store. That's the objective."

**Start with the outcome, not the route.** Jonah: "Don't plan the pitch meeting yet. Say what is true when it worked."

## What would be true (Pluma's draft of the signs; Maya and Jonah confirm or rewrite)

1. **Every store.** The chain's shelves carry our kits in all of its stores.
2. **A buyer's yes in writing.** A chain's purchasing team has sent a stocking agreement.
3. **More than one chain asks.** Two chains want the kits, so the terms are ours to set. ("is there more than one who wants this?")
4. **A kit for every season.** Four kits ship, one per season, not only spring.
5. **Proof a buyer would believe.** Sell-through numbers from our own shop and two pilot stores.

## The number

Open. On 2026-10-18 they talked about 400 stores; the number moves with how many chains ask.

## Ratchet

Calibrated monthly on the signs. Ahead of pace, this is raised the same month.

| Date | Change | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-18 | Set: a chain says yes within twelve months | Maya and Jonah, at the studio, after the first owner digest |
| 2026-10-18 | Raised: every store within twelve months, a yes becomes a sign on the way | Maya: "Every store. That's the objective." |
